verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a business SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Rippling offering a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of its core HR and payroll product. The only hosting reference is to Rippling-hosted integrations deployed through the CLI, and the developer sandbox and APIs are building blocks, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
